no_adcom_quote.quote: The NDA was not presented to an Advisory Committee; no one on the review team thought that a public discussion was needed prior to taking an action.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the INGREZZA (valbenazine) NDA209241 approval. The review division determined on January 4, 2017 that a public discussion was not needed because, although valbenazine is a new molecular entity, it shares a mechanism of action with the previously approved VMAT2 inhibitor tetrabenazine, the primary endpoint (AIMS) was well accepted with a clear effect size, and no major safety issues precluding approval were identified. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
